chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), that he said:
Eat pomegranates with their fat (membrane), for it is a tanner (cleanser) of the stomach.

key_terms.بِشَحْمِهِ: With its fat/membrane (referring to the white inner skin)
key_terms.دِبَاغُ: Tanner/Cleanser (literally one that tans leather, implying it toughens or cleanses the stomach lining)

ai.seo_question: What is the medicinal benefit of eating pomegranate with its membrane according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (a.s.) highlights the medicinal value of the pomegranate's white inner membrane (shahm), describing it as a 'tanner' of the stomach, which in traditional medicine implies firming and cleansing the digestive tract. This reflects the broader Shia emphasis on integrating prophetic dietary practices with physical health, viewing food as both nourishment and a means of spiritual and bodily purification.
